items.title: Return signed Nutzungsvertrag (both copies)
items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benötigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: This is a private-law contractual deadline, not an administrative act, so the standard rule for periods expressed 'ab' an event applies (§187 Abs. 1 BGB): the day of the triggering event (Briefdatum = 18.11.2026, a Wednesday) is not counted; the period begins the next day, 19.11.2026. The letter defines 'Werktage' itself as Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting only such working days starting 19.11.2026: 19.11 Thu (1), 20.11 Fri (2), 21.11 Sat (3), 22.11 Sun (not counted), 23.11 Mon (4), 24.11 Tue (5), 25.11 Wed (6), 26.11 Thu (7), 27.11 Fri (8), 28.11 Sat (9), 29.11 Sun (not counted), 30.11 Mon (10), 01.12 Tue (11), 02.12 Wed (12), 03.12 Thu (13), 04.12 Fri (14). No NW public holidays fall in this window. The 14th working day is Friday, 04.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed under the letter's own weekend/holiday rule.
